curriculum.subject: LANGUAGE_ARTS
curriculum.description: Students analyze words with affixes by identifying and attaching common prefixes and suffixes to base words. Focus: Decoding words using knowledge of prefixes (un-, re-, pre-) and suffixes (-ed, -ing, -ly). Examples: unhappy, rewrite, preview, jumped, playing, quickly, redo, dislike, walker, helpful. Constraints: Highlight the base word and affix in different colors in the word-builder.

status: authored; catalog-checked; each binding generator-probed once; not hydrated as a lesson; not runtime-tested
learnerAction: Read and build words from a base word plus one prefix or suffix, and say what the affix changes.

components.title: Read Words With Endings
components.intent: Grade 2. Cold-read base words with -ing and -ed; after each read the tutor shows base + ending.

components.title: Build a Word From Its Meaning
components.intent: Grade 2 prefixes un-, re-, pre- and suffixes -ed, -ing, -ly on familiar base words with no spelling change (unhappy, redo, preview, jumped, playing, quickly).

components.title: New Words, Same Parts
components.intent: Grade 2, fresh base words; same affixes. No word from the previous activity.

evidenceCriteria: Says the target word from its meaning with the parts board visible (word-builder).
The objective says "attaching": the child never puts parts together; they only say the finished word.
coverageLimits: word-builder raises simple_affix to a grade 3 floor (gemini-word-builder.ts:197-199) and the workspace says grades 3-8, so the grade 2 vocabulary request is overridden (probe returned "Grade 3").
word-workout read_inflected is a code-owned list of 12 CVC words with -s/-ing/-ed. No prefixes and no -ly.
word-workout prints the whole curriculum objective as its title (probe).

recommendation.rationale: Give word-builder a grade 2 band and a build response: the child taps prefix/root/suffix cards to make the word for a meaning. This is the open-build modality (OB-3 already lists word-builder). See brief 3.
